effect.name: Invert
effect.description: Photo-negative. Cheap, loud, and reads through anything: a good one-frame hit stinger, a "wrong answer" blink, or a hazard that should never be mistaken for scenery.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Amount
parameter.description: 0 is the original, 1 is fully inverted, 0.5 is flat grey.

parameter.name: Luminance Only
parameter.description: On, only the brightness flips and the hue survives. Off, every channel flips.
